name: 奉仕終了の確認フォーム
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create exactly ONE Lighthouse LH11-0007 奉仕終了の確認フォーム. Image1 ORIGINAL Deputy source controls glyph geometry, optical proportions, alignment, spacing and fine controls, ahead of rough SECONDARY Japanese mock Image2. Restore source controls omitted by the mock: time and place selector triangles, small worked-status chip, add-place link, break start/end time selectors, remove-break trash glyph and add-break link. Image3 approved bus is white surfaces/forest gradient style only.
Compact white dialog on pure white #FFFFFF canvas, fine neutral border, softly rounded corners and subtle downward shadow. Logical640px wide, height only as needed for complete readable controls; high-resolution image. Header 「奉仕を終了する」 in Meiryo Bold20/28; modest source-faithful close X slate at right. First row two white select controls with labels 「開始時刻」「終了時刻」 and exact saved values 「08:30」「11:00」, small original triangular dropdown carets. Inset neutral divider. White place selector label 「担当場所」 value 「受付・ライトハウス」, with small white/green-outline status chip 「実施済み」 and small green dot, then quiet green link 「場所を追加」. Divider.
Break section 「休憩」: single compact aligned row with white selectors labelled 「種類」「時間」「開始時刻」「終了時刻」, values 「食事休憩」「27分」「10:26」「10:53」. Restore original break start/end values, not invented. At row right small white outlined status chip 「取得済み」 with green dot, then small slate trash glyph faithful to original bin geometry. Quiet forest-green text link 「休憩を追加」 below. Divider. Comment field label 「申し送り」 with placeholder 「気づいたことを記録」 in a white neutral-outline textarea. Footer quiet left text 「合計 2時間03分」 and right primary button 「奉仕を終了」.
All Japanese content above is required. No English, payroll, schedule backdrop, unrelated avatar or extra rows. Preserve existing localized main times and total;08:30–11:00 minus27minutes equals2時間03分. Existing mock omitted source break times;10:26–10:53 equals27minutes and is the actual source value. Do not infer other data.
Meiryo14/24 regular body,12/16 metadata, zero tracking; do not make all labels/body bold or shrink text to force fit. Original simple filled triangular carets, compact trash and X proportions; slate #526173 utility glyphs. Source purple links/focus become forest green; source red End shift is the completion primary action, adapted to official forest-gradient #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E, legible white label, gentle edge light. Retain green status meaning via tiny dots plus text on WHITE chips, no mint-filled chips or broad tinted panels. Restrained soft shadows and quiet aligned groups, no excessive gloss. Raster candidate only, no real form interaction implied.
reviewNotes: 原画優先で欠落していた時間/場所/休憩の選択三角、場所状態/追加、休憩開始終了/取得済み/削除/追加を復元。既存日本語と08:30/11:00、元の休憩10:26–10:53/27分、合計2時間03分の整合性を確認。紫操作/赤終了を森林緑の完了操作へ、状態は小緑点＋白チップ。全欄/操作/切れなしを実画像確認。実フォーム/書体同定は未検証、画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
